Container.Name: nocturne-api
Container.Overview: Step 2 of 4: Nocturne 0.2.7 API. Requires the Nocturne PostgreSQL template, prepared environment files and the nocturne custom network. Start after PostgreSQL is ready. Credentials and role-specific connection strings are in the private appdata environment file.
Container.Requires: Run nocturne/prepare.sh before installation. Requires all four Nocturne containers, a custom Docker network named nocturne, generated private environment files and an HTTPS reverse proxy. See ReadMe.

Config.Name: Public hostname
Config.Description: Hostname only, without protocol or path. Must match both API and Web and your HTTPS proxy.
